channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: O favoritismo de Lula contra todos os rivais em 1º e 2º turno, segundo nova pesquisa
item.description: Lula leads the 2026 presidential race with 48% in the second round against Flávio Bolsonaro (41%), within the margin of error, and wins all second-round scenarios against Ronaldo Caiado (45% to 40%), Renan Santos (46% to 32%), and Romeu Zema (46% to 37%). In the first round, Lula has 43% versus Bolsonaro's 29%, gaining 3 points since June while Bolsonaro lost 2.

item.title: Lulinha: entenda nova investigação da PF autorizada pelo STF
item.description: Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha and son of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, is under investigation by the Federal Police after authorization by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça. The probe examines alleged corruption and influence peddling in the Ministry of Health related to medicinal cannabis deals involving his associate Roberta Luchsinger and lobbyist Antônio Camilo Antunes ('Careca do INSS'), who is detained over illegal pension schemes at INSS. Federal Police documents show R$1.5 million transferred from the lobbyist to Roberta, with notes suggesting funds were for 'the son of the guy,' possibly Lulinha, though Roberta claims the money was for consulting services rendered to the lobbyist.

item.title: Petistas divulgam vídeo de Lula com dez dedos, mas Justiça Eleitoral não vê motivo para punir uso de ‘IA’
item.description: A video shared by PT supporters shows Lula with all ten fingers, seemingly restoring a finger lost in a 1960s workplace accident through digital editing. The Electoral Justice of Ceará rejected a PL request to remove the post, stating there is no technical evidence of AI use, only conventional audiovisual editing. A definitive analysis of the publication’s validity is still pending.

item.title: Entorno de Tarcísio vê falta de peso em agenda econômica de Flávio
item.description: The entourage of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas assesses that Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign lacks weight in the economic area, with the financial market disappointed by the absence of a reference figure to communicate the senator's proposals. Economist Daniella Marques, tipped as a vice-presidential candidate and former president of Caixa Econômica Federal, is seen as lacking sufficient experience to lend credibility to the economic plan, still being associated with the role of 'Paulo Guedes' aide.

item.title: Saiba quais pesquisas eleitorais podem sair nesta 6ª feira
item.description: Electoral polls registered with the TSE are cleared for publication starting this Friday (July 31, 2026), covering national and state-level scenarios in eight states. Poder360 promotes its Electoral Poll Aggregator as a tool to access election data since 2000, filtered for registered studies with known methodologies. Subscribers can access the aggregator, while non-submitters may send polls for publication via email.

item.title: Agenda de Lula: leia os compromissos do presidente nesta 6ª feira
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) has a schedule in Ceará on Friday, July 31, 2026, with travel from Brasília to Fortaleza in the afternoon. His agenda includes a meeting with Minister Bruno Moretti (Planning) at the Planalto Palace at 9 a.m., arrival at Fortaleza Air Base at 4:30 p.m., a visit to the Ceará University Hospital (HUC) at 5 p.m. accompanied by the Ministers of Education (Leonardo Barchini), Health (Alexandre Padilha) and Institutional Relations (José Guimarães), followed by participation in the Ceará PT State Convention, which will launch the re-election bid of Governor Elmano de Freitas.

item.title: Lula é desaprovado por 50,3% e aprovado por 48,9%, diz pesquisa
item.description: Lula has 50.3% disapproval and 48.9% approval according to Vox Brasil poll released on July 31, 2026, with a margin of error of 2.15 percentage points. The survey interviewed 2,100 people between July 26 and 28 and is registered with the TSE under number BR-01084/2026. The poll also measured rejection of presidential candidates, though specific results are not detailed in the provided excerpt.

item.title: Lula tem 47,5% contra 41,1% de Flávio no 2º turno, diz pesquisa
item.description: A Vox Brasil poll released on July 31, 2026, shows Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva leading Flávio Bolsonaro in a hypothetical second-round presidential matchup with 47.5% to 41.1%, within the survey’s 2.15-point margin of error. The poll also tested Lula against former governors Romeu Zema and Ronaldo Caiado. Conducted between July 26–28, 2026, with 2,100 respondents nationwide, the study cost R$50,000 and was self-funded, registered with the TSE under BR-01084/2026.

item.title: Benedita e Crivella lideram disputa pelo Senado no RJ, diz pesquisa
item.description: Benedita da Silva (PT) and Marcelo Crivella (Republicanos) lead the race for Rio de Janeiro's two Senate seats, with 29.8% and 25.4% of voter intentions, respectively, according to a Paraná Pesquisas survey released on July 31, 2026. The 2.5-point margin of error indicates a technical tie between the two candidates. The poll surveyed 1,600 people across 58 municipalities in Rio de Janeiro state from July 28–30, with 95% confidence and TSE registration RJ-09303/2026.

item.title: Saiba o que os pré-candidatos e candidatos ao Planalto farão nesta 6ª
item.description: Lula holds meetings in Brasília and Fortaleza, including a ministerial meeting, a visit to the University Hospital of Ceará, and attendance at the PT state convention launching Elmano de Freitas' re-election bid. Caiado attends the National Mangalarga Marchador Horse Expo in Belo Horizonte. Cury gives multiple interviews and meets with economist Marcos Lisboa. Agendas for other candidates were not disclosed.

item.title: Governo Lula: leia a agenda de ministros do governo nesta 6ª feira
item.description: On Friday (July 31, 2026), ministers in Lula's government carry out agendas focused on public health, automotive industry, violence against women, and transportation infrastructure. Highlights include visits to the Ceará University Hospital by Lula, Alexandre Padilha, Leonardo Barchini, and José Guimarães; Márcio Elias Rosa's meeting with union leaders and visit to the Toyota factory in Sorocaba; a national mobilization against femicide in Bahia featuring Wellington Dias, Márcia Lopes, and Janja; and George Santoro's inspection of roadworks in Mato Grosso do Sul.

item.title: Ao STF, 14 de 21 partidos já negaram ingerência de presidentes sobre emendas
item.description: Of the 21 parties summoned by Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino to clarify potential interference in parliamentary amendments, 14 have responded so far, all denying that their presidencies control quotas, reserves, or any mechanism over the funds. Seven parties have not yet responded. The replies support the thesis of no direct partisan interference in the distribution of amendments.

item.title: Caiado compara Lulinha a Flávio Bolsonaro: "Pai que protege filho"
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) compared former president Lula and his son Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) to a disguised monarchy, after the STF authorized the PF to investigate Lulinha for alleged corruption and influence peddling in the Ministry of Health related to medicinal cannabis. Caiado accused Lula of shielding his son, despite the president's pledge not to use his office to benefit him. Lulinha's lawyer called the investigation a 'fishing expedition'.

item.title: Gilberto Kassab: “Nem PT nem Bolsonaro”
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, leader of the PSD, states that his party refuses to align with either the PT or Bolsonarism, advocating a third way for the 40% of voters dissatisfied with polarization. He supports Ronaldo Caiado as the presidential candidate and sees potential for growth in the center-right after the election, believing Caiado could surpass Lula in a potential runoff.

item.title: Insultos de Milei prenunciam um inédito cenário de internacionalização das eleições de outubro
item.description: At the PL convention that formalized Flávio Bolsonaro as the presidential candidate, Argentine President Javier Milei delivered an aggressive speech, insulting Brazilian President Lula, the Supreme Federal Court, and Minister Alexandre de Moraes, calling Lula a 'convict' and 'thief' and Moraes 'bald trash'. The Brazilian government responded with an official note from Itamaraty, summoned the Argentine ambassador for explanations, and recalled its ambassador from Argentina, while Lula replied with irony, asking 'Who is this guy?'

item.title: SobeDesce: de Zidane a Neymar
item.description: Zinédine Zidane became head coach of the French national team at age 54, aiming to win the 2030 World Cup. WhatsApp introduced web-based video and audio calls and call transfer between mobile and desktop. Pixar’s Toy Story 5 surpassed $1 billion in global box office, becoming the top-grossing film of 2026. Neymar, after a subdued World Cup performance and controversial call-up, declared the end of his international career with Brazil. The MDB announced it will not endorse a presidential candidate for the first time in 20 years due to national division. A BBC documentary accuses Jared Leto of sexual abuse, based on testimonies from multiple women.

item.title: Ele voltará a crescer?
item.description: An opinion poll of 669 readers shows that 89.4% believe Flávio Bolsonaro has already lost his chances to grow in election polls, while only 10.6% think he could still recover support. The content is linked to political criticism and the perceived decline of his ticket with Tereza Cristina.

item.title: 'Flávio Bolsonaro, um candidato distante'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign faced another crisis with the unexpected replacement of his campaign strategist, revealing instability in his team and difficulties in political coordination. The incident, described as part of a daily pattern of problems, suggests fragility in the campaign's organization. Full access to the article requires a subscriber-only link.

item.title: Cúpula do TSE avalia que governo Lula errou ao recusar visto de funcionários de Trump
item.description: The leadership of Brazil's Superior Electoral Court (TSE) deemed it a mistake for the Lula government to deny visas to two U.S. government officials who planned to visit Brazil to discuss freedom of expression in the context of the 2026 elections. The decision was seen as harmful to institutional dialogue between the countries and potentially damaging to the international perception of Brazil's electoral process.

item.title: Lula vive crise diplomática com aliados de Trump na América Latina
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's government is facing diplomatic tensions with Argentina and Paraguay, both aligned with Donald Trump, after Lula referenced Paraguay's 1864 invasion of Brazil during a speech on national defense. Paraguay is set to deliver an official note to Brazil's ambassador in protest, while the U.S. has imposed new tariffs on Brazilian goods and extended the national emergency declaration against Brazil for another year, raising Lula's concerns about potential U.S. interference in the 2026 presidential elections.

item.title: Novo diz que Cury tentou "chamar atenção" com proposta de chapa a Zema
item.description: The campaign of Romeu Zema (Novo) believes Augusto Cury (Avante) proposed a presidential ticket merely to attract attention, as Novo refuses to relinquish its own candidacy. According to AtlasIntel poll, Zema has 2.8% and Cury 1.6% of voting intentions. Zema’s team advocates for a pure Novo ticket and rules out agreements with Joaquim Barbosa or Cury withdrawing to become vice.

item.title: Pressão sobre combustíveis pode afetar campanha eleitoral de Lula
item.description: Rising fuel prices, driven by geopolitical tensions between Iran and the U.S. and the gradual end of price containment mechanisms, could become a political liability for Lula ahead of the 2026 elections. The government is attempting to avoid immediate consumer impacts through subsidies and tax exemptions, particularly on diesel, but oil volatility (around $81/barrel) undermines predictability and raises the risk of another price shock at the pump.

item.title: PL dá última cartada para atrair União Progressista à chapa de Flávio
item.description: The PL is banking on Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) accepting the vice-presidential spot on Flávio Bolsonaro’s ticket to persuade the Progressive Union (PP and Brazil Union) federation to endorse the presidential bid, after she had previously resisted the offer. The senator, tied to agribusiness and influential among female voters and the productive sector, now signals willingness to join the ticket, which the PL sees as a 'last card' to overcome the federation’s neutrality. The final composition still depends on a decision by the PP and Brazil Union parties.

item.title: Crise com Lula expõe fragilidades da política externa de Javier Milei
item.description: The diplomatic crisis between Brazil and Argentina escalated after Argentine President Javier Milei attacked Lula and Brazilian authorities during the PL convention that officially launched Flávio Bolsonaro as a presidential candidate. Experts say Milei’s foreign policy has shifted from state-centered diplomacy to ideological alignment with figures like Trump and Bolsonaro, causing tangible diplomatic costs. Brazil responded with strong measures, summoning ambassadors for consultations and issuing formal protests.

item.title: Ministros do STF monitoram atuação de André Mendonça na nova investigação contra Lulinha
item.description: Supreme Court justices are closely monitoring Justice André Mendonça's role in the investigation into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, the son of President Lula. Lulinha is suspected of influence peddling and corruption in a case drawing significant political and judicial attention. The article is subscriber-only and requires registration for full access.

item.title: ‘Fator STF’ ajudou a aumentar resistência do Centrão a fazer aliança com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Talks to include Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) as Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) running mate are stalled due to resistance from leaders of the União Brasil/PP federation and Republicanos, who are reluctant to align with an opposition campaign amid the so-called 'STF Factor,' which heightens political risk aversion.

item.title: Com dívida pública acima de R$ 10 tri, Lula deve terminar o terceiro mandato com déficit nominal recorde
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's third term is projected to close with the highest nominal deficit in over two decades, reaching 8.6% of GDP, according to exclusive projections. The indicator includes revenues, expenditures, and interest payments on public debt, which has surpassed R$10 trillion. The article highlights fiscal pressure and challenges in balancing public accounts.

item.title: Ex-ministro de Bolsonaro sugeriu a Vorcaro aproximação com PT da Bahia
item.description: Former minister Fábio Faria advised Daniel Vorcaro of Banco Master to approach the Bahia PT, according to a PF report submitted to the STF. The messages reveal an effort to expand political influence in the state, despite Vorcaro having received support from ACM Neto (União Brasil), a PT opponent. The document suggests Faria viewed rapprochement with the Bahia PT, especially Jaques Wagner, as feasible, though no concrete actions or Vorcaro’s response were recorded.

item.title: PSD traça estratégia para Caiado após oficialização de Kassab na vice
item.description: The PSD is implementing a strategy for Ronaldo Caiado's presidential campaign, with Gilberto Kassab as vice, aiming to mobilize the party's broad base of mayors, especially in São Paulo's interior, to support Caiado over Flávio Bolsonaro. The effort also seeks to bring Tarcísio de Freitas closer to Caiado, dubbed 'Carcísio', to make the alliance more palatable for mayors aligned with the São Paulo governor. This move is seen as critical for Caiado to rise in polls by September to avoid losing allied support.

item.title: PF cita Jaques Wagner em possível visita a ilha ligada ao Master
item.description: The Federal Police cited Senator Jaques Wagner (PT-BA) in a report from Operation Compliance Zero, indicating that he and his wife visited Ilha da Paixão in October 2023, a property linked to Augusto Ferreira Lima, former partner of Banco Master. The PF relied on messages, flight records, and photographs from seized cell phones, including an audio from Wagner confirming the invitation and a thank-you message from his wife after the visit. The investigation was made public by Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça on July 30, 2026.

item.title: Uma boa e uma má notícia para Flávio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro received a favorable signal from Senator Tereza Cristina as a potential running mate, but simultaneously had to replace his campaign manager for the third time in a few months, revealing instability in campaign communications. The situation highlights the Bolsonaro family's tendency to directly intervene in communications, causing operational chaos.

item.title: Cinco razões que levam Tereza Cristina a ser uma boa opção para Flávio
item.description: Columnist Fernando Schüler outlines five reasons why Tereza Cristina would be a strong vice-presidential pick for Flávio Bolsonaro in 2026: her prominence as a female leader, strong ties to agribusiness, Congressional articulation skills, seniority and institutional weight, and the potential for a strategic party alliance. He notes that Centrão leaders have previously criticized Bolsonaro’s 2022 choice of Braga Netto, implying Tereza Cristina would have been a better option.

item.title: Fracasso do Move Brasil e extensão do Desenrola expõem interesse eleitoreiro
item.description: The Move Brazil program, launched with R$ 30 billion to subsidize vehicle purchases for taxi drivers, app-based drivers, delivery workers, and cyclists, achieved very low uptake, with disbursements near R$ 3 billion and realistic projections between R$ 5 and R$ 6 billion. President Lula criticized banks for the low adhesion, but analysts argue the failure stems from flawed program design, not just financial institutions’ actions. The initiative is seen as having electoral motives, given its timing ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: É difícil combater desconfiança no sistema eleitoral
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro expressed distrust in Brazil’s electoral system during an event with diplomats, prompting international attention. According to the Washington Post, the Trump administration dispatched two State Department advisers to Brazil to assess the integrity of the electoral process. The issue of confidence in electronic voting machines is once again becoming central to political discourse in the country.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro troca marqueteiro, mas parece precisar de um milagreiro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro fired his second campaign strategist in two months, highlighting ongoing struggles in his 2026 electoral bid. The personnel change reflects an attempt to improve weak polling numbers, though analysts suggest the challenges may extend beyond messaging to deeper structural or reputational issues.

item.title: Com aval de Valdemar e novo marqueteiro, Flávio tenta resgatar estratégia de Bolsonaro em 2022
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro hired Duda Lima, the marketer behind Jair Bolsonaro’s 2022 campaign, with the endorsement of PL president Valdemar Costa Neto, to reorganize his 2026 presidential strategy. The move aims to restore disciplined, theme-based communication — including weekly live streams and electoral system critiques — after weeks of reactive crisis management without a clear narrative. Allies emphasize the goal is not to replicate 2022 but to adapt its logic to the current context, integrating TV, radio, social media, and press around a few core themes.

item.title: Missão realiza congresso com ingressos de até R$ 8.014 em SP
item.description: The Mission party will hold its 1st Congress in São Paulo on August 1, 2026, with tickets ranging from R$ 94 to R$ 8.014, presenting the presidential candidacy of Renan Santos, already officially nominated. The event includes VIP access, autographs, lunch with party leaders, and Federal Police protection due to threats from criminal factions. Additional congresses are scheduled in Curitiba and Joinville with varied pricing and free admission for party members.

item.title: Kataguiri chama Eduardo de “patético” e o desafia: “Vem me bater”
item.description: Deputy Kim Kataguiri (Missão-SP) responded to former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL-SP), who said he had the 'desire to beat up these guys [from MBL]', by calling Eduardo a 'coward' and challenging him to a physical confrontation during an interview on MathiasTV. Kataguiri also criticized Eduardo's self-exile in the United States, accusing him of fleeing at the first sign of possible arrest after his June 2026 conviction by the STF to 4 years and 2 months in semi-open regime for coercion in the course of justice.

item.title: Cidades e Transportes são áreas mais beneficiadas por liberação de R$ 5,7 bi do orçamento
item.description: The Lula government released R$ 5.7 billion from the annual budget, primarily benefiting the Ministries of Cities (R$ 1.2 billion) and Transport (R$ 1.015 billion), due to reduced spending on pensions, BPC, and personnel. The funds were unblocked ahead of the 2026 election campaign, with part allocated to parliamentary amendments.

item.title: Mudou de cor? Quatro anos após polêmica ACM Neto se declara branco ao TSE
item.description: Four years after controversy over declaring himself pardo in 2022, ACM Neto changed his racial self-declaration to white in the TSE for the 2026 elections, reigniting identity debates. His wealth also increased by 103.5% over the period, rising from R$ 41.7 million to R$ 84.9 million, with notable growth in real estate funds and a new apartment in Barra Grande.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro travam batalha decisiva no Sudeste, com disputas embaralhadas nos estados
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro are locked in a decisive battle for control of Brazil’s three largest electoral colleges — São Paulo, Minas Gerais, and Rio de Janeiro — according to a new Genial/Quaest poll. The contest reflects national polarization, with the Southeast as the central battleground between the PT government and Bolsonarist opposition.

item.title: Campanha de Flávio com novo marqueteiro terá ajustes, e não guinada direitista, dizem integrantes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) campaign stated that the change in marketing advisors was driven by professional reasons, such as lack of organization and misalignment with political leadership, denying any ideological shift to the right. Campaign members emphasized that the adjustment aims to improve operational efficiency, not to alter the campaign's ideological direction.

item.title: Impasse entre TSE e STF trava eleição para Governo de Roraima
item.description: The gubernatorial election in Roraima remains unresolved following a supplementary election held on June 21, due to a disagreement between the TSE and STF over the validity of results or interim measures. The lack of consensus between the two high courts is preventing the inauguration of the winner and creating political uncertainty in the state. This jurisdictional impasse is blocking the normalization of the local electoral process.

item.title: Kassab explica por que não vai à convenção que indicará Tarcísio
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD and vice-presidential candidate on Ronaldo Caiado’s ticket, explained why he will not attend the Republicans’ convention that will formally nominate Tarcísio de Freitas. He stated his absence is due to party and strategic commitments aligned with his own candidacy. The event, set for August 1st, will formally establish Tarcísio as the Republicans’ candidate for governor of São Paulo.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest testa impacto de Milei e decisão de Moraes na disputa Lula x Flávio
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll for the 2026 Brazilian presidential election examines how recent events — such as Javier Milei’s endorsement of Flávio Bolsonaro, Alexandre de Moraes’ ruling restricting visits to Jair Bolsonaro, and potential Trump support — may influence voter intentions between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The survey also evaluates government approval, economic perception, institutional trust, and other political and social issues.

item.title: Renan Santos expande base digital e ‘fura a bolha’, diz cientista de dados
item.description: Renan Santos stood out in the weekly social media report, gaining over 80,000 new followers, surpassing 2 million followers, and achieving the highest engagement rate among analyzed politicians. According to Alek Maracajá, CEO of Ativaweb, this is because he 'breaks the bubble' digitally, communicating more freely and leveraging platform algorithms effectively. Other figures like Lula, Ronaldo Caiado, and Flávio Bolsonaro also saw growth, but to a lesser extent.

item.title: Lulinha e a PF: Mendonça dá um presentão a Flávio, é claro!
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized an inquiry into Fábio Luís da Silva, known as Lulinha, over alleged lobbying access to presidential and health ministry officials. The investigation, tied to the INSS scandal, is seen as an effort to implicate President Lula, while Bolsonaro allies use it to mirror Flávio Bolsonaro’s own legal troubles. The move is framed as a political gift to Flávio’s campaign, creating a narrative of mutual persecution.

item.title: “Não tem nada de errado”, diz Flávio sobre vídeo de Jair feito com IA
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro defended the legality of the AI-generated video of Jair Bolsonaro shown at the PL convention, stating that his team reviewed TSE rules and found no violation due to the upfront disclosure about AI use. He said the video only asks for support for his candidacy and that Jair Bolsonaro had no prior knowledge of its production. The remarks came after Alexandre de Moraes ordered the defense to clarify whether the former president authorized the image use, warning that lack of consent could shift liability to Flávio’s campaign and the PL.

item.title: Lula chama Eduardo Bolsonaro de “filho do satanás”
item.description: In an interview with the podcast Inteligência Ltda., President Lula called Eduardo Bolsonaro 'son of Satan', accusing him of working against Brazil from the United States due to his ties with the Trump administration and his role in promoting the 2025 tariff increase. Lula further claimed that Trump and Secretary of State Marco Rubio would attempt to interfere in Brazil's 2026 elections to favor Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, and criticized Rubio for his Cuban heritage and alleged anti-Latin America stance.

item.title: “Ja imaginaram se fosse filho do Bolsonaro?”, diz Flávio sobre Lulinha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL's presidential candidate, criticized the Federal Police for lacking resources to investigate Lulinha, son of President Lula, who is suspected of influence peddling and corruption in dealings with lobbyist 'Careca do INSS'. He questioned whether Jair Bolsonaro's son would face the same lax investigation if accused of diverting pensioners' funds. Flávio announced a new live stream on August 6 to clarify the PL's state-level alliances and reduce voter confusion.
